title: Round 33's net2 with its belief in copies from net1 v7's traffic head, validation links
description: Trained to read net1 v7's traffic head, round 33's net2 (exp-net2-r33-traffic-302, iteration 59) gained beside a Cubic flow that started first (+0.052 to +0.058 minus BBRv3 over three seeds, against -0.029 to +0.016 for round 29's net2) but not among copies (-0.115 against -0.081), while round 29's actors with both beliefs taken from the head gained +0.419 among copies and lost 0.14 with Cubic first (exp-traffic-r33-val-303). If what helps beside Cubic is the student's own belief in a stock flow (p) and what helps among copies is the head's belief in copies (q), the two together keep both. This runs round 33's students with q from the head they read and p their own (net2-r33h, gate_ensemble_export.py --traffic), beside the same students unchanged (net2-r33), round 29's (net2-v7), round 29's with both beliefs from the head (net2-v7hp) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7), all thresholds at 0.5, on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies. Reading, stated before the results: the combination works if net2-r33h gains at least 0.05 over net2-v7 among copies and loses no more than 0.02 on the five-family mean, both over three seeds.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); H="$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; echo "62043107ace9c7c3c913124f42d26023474ec6108cc59d959475da6bd57820be  $H" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hp-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H" --traffic-p; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s$s"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s$s"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/traffic_head.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cmp "$e/traffic_head.pt" "$H"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33-s$s" "$e" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33h-s$s" "$e" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H"; for a in v7 v7hp r33 r33h; do P+=(--policy "net2-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 26 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
